name: GET /api/admin/voice-agent/analytics - Voice analytics across tenants (operator)
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token). Same shape as the tenant route, for one tenant (tenant_id) or every tenant. Per-stage latency, provider errors and cost per call are queryable per tenant (f1505157-f83f-43e5-91db-3018d0ad56f1#AC3): latency_ms { turns, stt, ttft, llm, voice_to_voice: { p50, p95 } } from voice.turn_metrics (the runtime's Kafka topic voice.turn.metrics.v1); errors { provider_failovers, llm_failed_turns, tool_errors, by_provider[] }; cost { calls, minutes, costed_calls, total_usd, per_call_usd, basis } from voice.call_facts (written at every call end; cost = the runtime's cost_breakdown.total_usd, else the speech-catalog list price x duration); daily[]. A p95 voice-to-voice regression (last VOICE_P95_WINDOW_MIN=60 min vs a VOICE_P95_BASELINE_DAYS=7 baseline, +VOICE_P95_REGRESSION_PCT=25%, >= 50 turns each) opens ONE sdk-incident voice.latency.p95_regression per tenant (checked every 15 min). Query: from, to (ISO, default the last 7 days, at most 400 days), agent_id, include_tests=true. 503 AnalyticsUnavailable when ClickHouse is not enabled on the deployment. Errors: bad tenant_id or window 400; missing ops token 401.

errorCases.message: voice analytics (ClickHouse) is not available on this deployment
